name: mestrecs-agent-skills
description: Open Agent Skills for running many AI coding chats in parallel on one repository.

plugins.name: parallel-worktree-pr-merge-end-to-end
plugins.description: Run many AI coding chats in parallel on the same repo without one breaking another: each gets its own worktree, then pull request, tests, cross-model review and merge, end to end.

plugins.name: codex-gemini-subagents-for-claude-code
plugins.description: Send Claude Code subagent work to Codex CLI or Gemini / Antigravity CLI per chat instead of spending Claude quota, enforced by a PreToolUse guard hook with verified ceiling fallback and exception audit logging.
